description: Provision a Google Cloud Kms KMSCryptoKey via Config Connector. Fields mirror the kms.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 KMSCryptoKey spec.

destroyScheduledDuration.description: Immutable. The period of time that versions of this key spend in the DESTROY_SCHEDULED state before transitioning to DESTROYED. If not specified at creation time, the default duration is 24 hours.

importOnly.description: Immutable. Whether this key may contain imported versions only.

keyRingRef.description: The KMSKeyRing that this key belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed KMSKeyRing resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/keyRings/{{keyRingID}}".

name.description: The name of a KMSKeyRing resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a KMSKeyRing resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

purpose.description: Immutable. The immutable purpose of this CryptoKey. See the [purpose reference](https://cloud.google.com/kms/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys#CryptoKeyPurpose) for possible inputs. Default value is "ENCRYPT_DECRYPT".

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

rotationPeriod.description: Every time this period passes, generate a new CryptoKeyVersion and set it as the primary. The first rotation will take place after the specified period. The rotation period has the format of a decimal number with up to 9 fractional digits, followed by the letter 's' (seconds). It must be greater than a day (ie, 86400).

skipInitialVersionCreation.description: Immutable. If set to true, the request will create a CryptoKey without any CryptoKeyVersions. You must use the 'google_kms_key_ring_import_job' resource to import the CryptoKeyVersion.

versionTemplate.description: A template describing settings for new crypto key versions.

algorithm.description: The algorithm to use when creating a version based on this template. See the [algorithm reference](https://cloud.google.com/kms/docs/reference/rest/v1/CryptoKeyVersionAlgorithm) for possible inputs.

protectionLevel.description: Immutable. The protection level to use when creating a version based on this template. Possible values include "SOFTWARE", "HSM", "EXTERNAL", "EXTERNAL_VPC". Defaults to "SOFTWARE".

title: GCP Kms KMSCryptoKey
